content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID of
the process that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that
performed thread injection in an InjectedThread event
RawProcessId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process identifier
ParentProcessId
The decimal representation of the parent process.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.

SHA1HashData
The SHA1 hash of a file.  In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
MD5HashData
The MD5 hash of a file
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
CommandLine
The command line used to create this process. May be empty in some circumstances, visit here [ http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-
us/library/windows/desktop/ms682425(v=vs.85).aspx] for more information.
UserName
Operating system username.
UserSid
The User Security Identifier (UserSID) of the user who executed the command. A UserSID uniquely identifies a user in a system.
Values:
SELF_RID (0x01010000000000050A000000)
UserSecurityDomain
Domain for the file/process/registry owner (mapped from SID).
ProcessStartTime
The time the process began in UNIX epoch time (in decimal, non-hex format).
ProcessDuration
ProcessEndTime
The time the process finished (in decimal, non-hex format).

ProcessThreadInjectedStatus
UID

The real UID for a unix style process.
SVUID
The saved effective UID for a unix style process.
GID

RGID

SVGID

EnvironmentVariables
CurrentWorkingPath
VirtualMemorySize
Size, in KiB, of virtual address space allocated to a process.
ResidentSetSize
Size, in KiB, of memory physically allocated to a process.
MaxThreadCount
ProcessPriority
Scheduling priority value of a process.
ProcessNiceValue
Nice value of a process.
ControllingTerminal
Name of the controlling terminal of a process.
TtyName
Name of attached TTY/PTY.
EnvironmentVariablesString
Environment variables separated by a space. The encoding is utf8.
